steps.title: Back up your files
steps.detail: Copy your documents and photos to an external drive or cloud storage. The new SSD starts empty.

steps.title: Buy an M.2 2280 NVMe SSD
steps.detail: The Example Laptop 14 has one M.2 2280 slot that takes NVMe or SATA SSDs. A 500 GB NVMe drive fits it.

steps.title: Remove the battery and the base cover
steps.detail: Shut down, unplug the charger, undo the two battery screws and lift the battery out, then remove the base cover.
steps.warning: Touch grounded metal before you handle internal parts, to discharge static electricity.

steps.title: Install the SSD in the M.2 slot
steps.detail: Insert the SSD into the M.2 slot at an angle, press it flat and fasten it with its screw.

steps.title: Reinstall the operating system and restore your files
steps.detail: Reattach the cover and battery, install the operating system from a USB stick, then copy your files back.
